title: Performance of the Southern African Large Telescope High Resolution Spectrograph
what_was_studied: Commissioning of the dual-arm fibre-fed spectrograph
numerical_result: HRS spans about 370 to 890 nm with nominal resolving-power modes from about 14000 to 65000
remaining_question: How do extracted resolving power and stability vary across arms and pipeline versions?

title: Commissioning the SALT High Resolution Spectrograph's iodine cell
what_was_studied: Cell characterization and HRS-specific iodine forward modelling
numerical_result: Calibration frames and on-sky spectra were used to commission precision-RV extraction for the HRS iodine mode
remaining_question: What long-baseline floor is reached with contemporaneous calibrations and stable stars?

title: HRS Pipeline
what_was_studied: Automatic MIDAS reductions and delivered radial-velocity accuracy
numerical_result: Default automatic products are reported below 300 m/s for LR, MR and HR modes without requiring same-night arcs and standards
remaining_question: This operational product accuracy is not the precision limit of dedicated iodine reductions

title: SALT Call for Proposals 2026-2
what_was_studied: Current availability, measured resolving power and pipeline limitations
numerical_result: HRS continues regular science; measured HR extraction is about R 44000 to 47500 and the current pipeline does not fully recover the nominal HR information
remaining_question: How much RV information is recovered by a tilted-line two-dimensional extraction?
